description.zh-CN: 拦截 BitTorrent 协议握手，以及公开 Tracker 的域名。协议识别需要入站开启嗅探，PSP 会在下发前检查，条件不满足时保持上一版策略。
description.en-US: Blocks the BitTorrent handshake and the domains of public trackers. Protocol detection needs sniffing on the inbound; PSP checks that before publishing and keeps the previous policy when it is not met.

description.zh-CN: 拦截 PT（私有 Tracker）站点的域名。
description.en-US: Blocks the domains of private-tracker (PT) sites.

description.zh-CN: 银行、券商与金融服务的域名：category-finance、中国券商，以及中国、日本、俄罗斯、伊朗、缅甸的银行分类。收录的是正规机构，不含高风险金融。
description.en-US: Domains of banks, brokers and financial services: category-finance, Chinese securities firms, and the bank categories of China, Japan, Russia, Iran and Myanmar. Regulated institutions only; high-risk finance is not covered.

description.zh-CN: 加密货币交易所、钱包与相关服务的域名（category-cryptocurrency）。
description.en-US: Domains of cryptocurrency exchanges, wallets and related services (category-cryptocurrency).

name.zh-CN: 学术与教育（中国、俄罗斯、伊朗与学术网站）
name.en-US: Scholarly and education (China, Russia, Iran and academic sites)

description.zh-CN: 中国、俄罗斯、伊朗的教育分类，学术网站分类（含中国、香港、英国、伊朗），以及中国 MOOC。这不是一个通用的「教育」分类：v2fly 没有这样的分类。
description.en-US: The education categories of China, Russia and Iran, the scholarly-site categories (including China, Hong Kong, the UK and Iran) and Chinese MOOCs. This is not a generic "education" category: v2fly has none.

description.zh-CN: 成人内容站点的域名（category-porn，约 6 600 条）。其中约 140 条是正则，会占用策略的 256 条正则额度。
description.en-US: Domains of adult-content sites (category-porn, about 6,600 entries). About 140 of them are regular expressions, which use the policy's quota of 256.

description.zh-CN: 广告网络与追踪服务的域名（category-ads-all）。
description.en-US: Domains of ad networks and tracking services (category-ads-all).

description.zh-CN: 代理隧道与 VPN 服务的域名（category-proxy-tunnels、category-vpnservices）。
description.en-US: Domains of proxy tunnels and VPN services (category-proxy-tunnels, category-vpnservices).

description.zh-CN: DNS over HTTPS 服务的域名（category-doh）。
拦截访问 25、465、587 端口（SMTP）的 TCP 连接，防止节点被用来发垃圾邮件。
description.en-US: Blocks TCP connections to ports 25, 465 and 587 (SMTP), so the node cannot be used to send spam.

description.zh-CN: 拦截访问私有与保留地址（含云厂商元数据地址）。Xray 的 freedom 出站对代理入站默认已经拦截这些地址，所以在 Xray 上这条主要起记录作用；sing-box 没有这个默认。
description.en-US: Blocks connections to private and reserved addresses, cloud metadata addresses included. Xray's freedom outbound already blocks them for proxy inbounds by default, so on Xray this mainly records; sing-box has no such default.

reason.zh-CN: v2fly 没有通用的「教育」分类，只有中国、俄罗斯、伊朗的教育分类（已包含在「学术与教育」里）。要覆盖其他国家，请用自定义列表或远程列表。
reason.en-US: v2fly has no generic "education" category, only the education categories of China, Russia and Iran (already part of "Scholarly and education"). To cover other countries, use a custom or remote list.

reason.zh-CN: v2fly 只有 category-payment-ir（伊朗），没有通用的支付分类；拿它冒充通用分类会漏掉绝大多数支付服务。请用自定义列表或远程列表。
reason.en-US: v2fly has only category-payment-ir (Iran) and no generic payment category; passing it off as one would miss most payment services. Use a custom or remote list.

reason.zh-CN: v2fly 只有仅覆盖俄罗斯的 category-betting-ru（十几条），没有通用的博彩分类。请用自定义列表或远程列表。
reason.en-US: v2fly has only category-betting-ru, which covers Russia alone (a dozen entries), and no generic gambling category. Use a custom or remote list.
